name: Grid squad tactics
summary: Move and attack with a small squad on a grid against a small enemy force, using terrain and range.
core_loop: select unit → move within range → attack → end turn → enemies act
rules: high ground and cover add bonuses
example_prompts: fire emblem but my squad is five hamsters
xcom with school kids vs aliens
turn based tactics in a haunted mall
advance wars with pizza armies

name: Telegraphed-enemy puzzle
summary: Enemies show exactly what they will do next; you reposition, block and redirect to make them hit each other or nothing.
core_loop: see enemy intents → move your pieces → end turn → intents resolve → next wave
win: survive N turns with buildings intact
example_prompts: into the breach but the mechs are cats
telegraphed tactics puzzle where monsters attack my kitchen
hoplite style board with a dragon

name: Territory conquest
summary: Take over neighboring regions by sending armies from your regions; more troops beat fewer, and income follows regions held.
core_loop: collect troops → pick source and target → compare strengths → gain region → income grows
rules: attacking needs more troops than the defender
example_prompts: risk but the regions are my school hallways
conquer a small map with cats vs dogs
polytopia on my phone with a hamster tribe

name: Auto-battler lineup
summary: Buy and place units in a lineup, then watch the fight resolve automatically; synergies reward the right comp.
core_loop: shop with gold → place units → round starts → auto-battle resolves → earn gold
rules: units gain synergy bonuses by tag
example_prompts: super auto pets with food
auto chess with wizards
auto battler where my lineup is school lunch ladies

name: Lane push elixir
summary: Deploy units from a hand using a refilling energy bar; units walk the lane on their own and push into the enemy base.
core_loop: wait for energy → drop a unit → units walk and clash → repeat → towers fall
rules: units cost energy that refills over time
the higher-HP tower wins at time-up
example_prompts: clash royale but everything is pizza
lane battler where i play cats vs dogs
push a lane with units that cost energy

name: Fog scouting
summary: You cannot see enemy pieces until scouted; spend actions on probes before committing a strike.
core_loop: probe a tile → reveal info → commit strike → hit or miss → continue
rules: probes reveal a number of nearby enemies
every miss gives the enemy a hint
example_prompts: battleship but it's a cursed pirate hunt
stratego style hidden pieces on a phone
find the hidden dragon nests with scouts

name: Territory painting race
summary: Move to claim tiles; the most territory when time ends wins, and crossing an opponent's trail can steal it.
core_loop: move to paint tiles → loop to claim an area → avoid trails → time ends → count
rules: a closed loop fills its inside
touching a trail pops that rival
example_prompts: paper.io but with ink and cats
splatoon style territory game for my phone
paint the school hallway before time runs out

name: Court intrigue
summary: Spend limited favor actions on courtiers; their loyalties shift and the throne goes to whoever you quietly back.
core_loop: choose a courtier → bribe, flatter or rumor → loyalties shift → vote → ruler decided
rules: each courtier has an ideal favor type
the vote is by majority of loyalty
example_prompts: game of thrones court intrigue with high school cliques
diplomacy style persuasion game
crusader kings but with cats

name: Counter-unit triangle
summary: Enemy waves arrive in known types; you assemble the countering army before each fight with limited supply.
core_loop: preview enemy composition → spend supply on counter units → fight resolves → carry survivors
rules: each unit type has a counter
example_prompts: age of empires counters with kitchen tools
rock paper scissors army builder
counter the dragon's army with cats

name: Formation then simulate
summary: Place your units on a formation grid, then watch both sides fight; reposition between rounds to fix what failed.
core_loop: place units → start battle → watch → see weak spot → rearrange → rerun
example_prompts: place a formation to stop the zombie horde
total war with hamsters
plan then watch a medieval fight

name: Allocate-troops fronts
summary: Split a fixed army across several fronts without seeing the opponent's split; win by taking most fronts.
core_loop: allocate soldiers per front → opponent splits too → reveal → fronts won counted
example_prompts: colonel blotto but with castles and cats
split your army across 5 fronts
divide your pizza troops among six hills

name: Resource engine expand
summary: Spend resources each turn to expand production, with limited slots so every build is a trade-off against another.
core_loop: collect income → pick a build → income grows → hit milestone → repeat
rules: builds cost resources and take a turn
a deadline turn sets the goal
win: hit the goal by the deadline
example_prompts: civilization on my phone for cats
catan like resource expansion on mars
build an economy engine and reach the goal in 20 turns

name: Worker placement
summary: Place workers on action slots; a slot taken blocks others, so order and timing make the difference.
core_loop: place a worker → resolve slot → opponent places → slots refill each round → count points
rules: each slot takes one worker per round
social_hooks: async worker placement with a friend
example_prompts: agricola for my group chat
place workers on a farm and race
lords of waterdeep but with school kids

name: Siege planning
summary: Pick which gate and tool to commit to for a siege, with scouts giving partial info on defenses.
core_loop: scout hints → pick method → siege resolves in several stages → result
rules: some tools are strong vs some defenses
social_hooks: defend a castle designed by a friend
example_prompts: siege a castle with a ladder and a catapult
breach a pizza fortress
scout then attack the dragon's tower

name: Pursuit on a graph
summary: Move a pawn along routes of a map while a pursuer closes in; the pursuer's moves are limited by ticket types.
core_loop: choose move along route → pursuer moves → clues about position → end after N turns
rules: pursuer sees you every few turns
example_prompts: scotland yard but the detective is my cat
evade a pursuer in a school map
chase game on a subway map

name: Sealed-bid auction
summary: Bid your budget for items whose values are only partly known; the best collection after N auctions wins.
core_loop: see item → place bid → winner pays → budget shrinks → tally
rules: items have a hidden true value with a hint
ties go to the earlier bidder
example_prompts: storage wars with school lockers
bid for dragon eggs
auction game where i outbid my friends on pizza

name: Repeated dilemma
summary: Choose to cooperate or defect against an opponent with a strategy across rounds; learn their pattern and exploit or trust.
core_loop: choose cooperate/defect → opponent chooses → payoff → repeat → compare totals
social_hooks: challenge a friend to the same game async
example_prompts: split or steal with my friends
evolution of trust mini game
golden balls inspired trust game

name: Supply lines
summary: Route supplies from depots to front lines along a network; a broken or overloaded link starves units.
core_loop: place link → supplies flow → forecast shortages → fix routes → survive the phase
example_prompts: supply lines to keep the camp alive
mini metro for army logistics
route food to hungry cats

name: Simultaneous orders
summary: Both sides secretly queue orders for each unit; then all orders resolve at once and you see who read the other better.
core_loop: queue orders → lock in → resolve simultaneously → see replay → repeat
rules: orders resolve in the same moment
example_prompts: frozen synapse but with school lunches
diplomacy orders between cats and dogs
plan simultaneous attacks on a map

name: District zoning
summary: Place districts on a small map where adjacencies add or subtract points and resources, balancing needs.
core_loop: draw tile → place on map → adjacency bonuses → keep resources positive → fill map
social_hooks: compare layouts of the same tile draw
example_prompts: islanders but with cats
plan a tiny town without putting the factory by the school
simcity zoning puzzle for 20 tiles

name: Card-driven territory
summary: Play unit cards to board tiles; unit position matters and cards also trigger actions when adjacent.
core_loop: draw → place unit → resolve adjacency → attack → end turn
example_prompts: duelyst but my deck is school clubs
place cards on a board to destroy a base
hearthstone with a grid

name: Action-point squad
summary: A team of specialists spend action points each turn on skills that complement; guards react after you commit.
core_loop: spend AP on moves and skills → end turn → guards react → repeat
example_prompts: invisible inc but the squad is school clubs
action point heist in a haunted museum
shadowrun like heist for my phone

name: Tech-tree race
summary: Choose research order on a small tree; each tech unlocks abilities, and order decides which crisis you can withstand.
core_loop: pick research → time passes → crisis hits → see if tech helps → continue
rules: each crisis is solved by a specific tech
example_prompts: civilization tech tree for a school science fair
research in the right order to survive a zombie winter
frostpunk style research choices

name: Capture-the-point skirmish
summary: Units move between control points; holding more points earns income to deploy more, in a short skirmish.
core_loop: deploy → move to point → fight → capture → income grows
rules: units win by numbers and counters
win: hold most points at time up
example_prompts: rts capture the points between cats and mice
command and conquer for my phone
hold more points than the dragon army

name: Commander and morale
summary: Issue a few orders to blocks of troops while their morale rises and falls; flanking and rout decide the fight.
core_loop: issue orders → blocks clash → morale shifts → rout or hold → next order
rules: a routed block can't be recalled
example_prompts: total war but my troops are sandwiches
rally the line against a goblin horde
morale based battle with cats

name: Dice-duel conquest
summary: Each territory holds a stack of dice; attack by rolling your stack against the neighbor's, winning the region on a higher sum.
core_loop: pick attacker → pick neighbor → roll both stacks → compare → winners reinforce
rules: dice are added at turn end
example_prompts: dice wars but the territories are lunch tables
risk with dice stacks and cats
conquer the map by rolling sums

name: Hidden-rank capture
summary: Pieces have secret ranks; when two meet the higher wins, so you bluff by moving unknown pieces boldly.
core_loop: move a piece → if it meets an enemy, ranks reveal → higher rank wins → capture the flag
example_prompts: stratego but with cats
hidden piece capture the flag
dark chess on a phone

name: Wind-fleet maneuvers
summary: Maneuver a fleet around a shifting wind that limits headings; line up broadsides before the enemy does.
core_loop: read wind → move ships → line up shot → fire → wind shifts
rules: ships cannot sail into the wind
example_prompts: sea battle with cat pirates
battleship but with wind direction
sail a fleet around a storm

name: Campaign allocation
summary: Spend limited days and funds across regions to win a majority of vote points, with polls giving partial feedback.
core_loop: read polls → choose region and activity → polls update → repeat → election day
rules: each region has a leaning and a size
example_prompts: run for school president and pick which grades to visit
campaign manager with cats
win the class vote with a limited budget

name: Mini 4X expansion
summary: A tiny map where you explore, settle sites, harvest and defend, with an overall turn limit and score.
core_loop: scout → settle → harvest → defend → count score
example_prompts: settle a planet of hamsters
polytopia-style mini map
explore expand exploit with cat colonies

name: Ecosystem balance
summary: Tune predator and prey populations by adding or removing species so the island stays alive for N seasons.
core_loop: view population chart → add or remove species → season passes → check trends → repeat
rules: predators lower prey but starve without them
example_prompts: balance wolves and rabbits on an island
spore ecosystem game for school science
keep the pond alive for 10 seasons

name: Triage and assign
summary: Limited rescuers must be assigned to groups with different urgency; assign the right ones in time or lose them.
core_loop: see groups and ETA → assign rescuers → time passes → results → next wave
example_prompts: evacuate a school during a dragon attack
assign rescue teams to flooded villages
triage the cats before the storm

name: Elemental combo tactics
summary: Combine element tiles on a grid so effects chain (fire spreads on oil, water conducts shock) to defeat enemies cleverly.
core_loop: read grid surfaces → cast element → effects chain → enemies damaged → repeat
win: defeat all enemies in the casts given
example_prompts: elemental combo puzzle with wizard cats
set oil on fire to beat the goblins
divinity style surface combos

name: Push-off arena
summary: On a small arena, push enemy units off the edge using shove actions; turn order and positioning decide who falls.
core_loop: choose unit → move and shove → enemies react → units pushed off edge are out → repeat
example_prompts: sumo tactics with cats on a pizza
push enemies off a floating island
turn-based smash bros with hamsters

name: Capture the flag grid
summary: Two sides on a grid race to snatch the opponent's flag and bring it home while avoiding tags.
core_loop: move units → grab flag → carry it home → tags send you back → score
example_prompts: capture the flag in my school
cat vs dog grid flag game
tactical capture the flag for two players

name: Capture-all piece puzzle
summary: A few chess-like pieces with fixed move rules; capture all targets in the fewest moves using only the moves they allow.
core_loop: view position → move a piece → captures remove targets → repeat → clear board
rules: each piece moves only by its rule
each move must capture or relocate
example_prompts: chess puzzle with a knight and two rooks
capture all pawns in 5 moves
knight capture puzzle for the daily

name: Kiting skirmish
summary: Control a ranged unit that must keep distance from melee enemies, firing between steps, to clear a skirmish.
core_loop: move away → fire when in range → enemies approach → retreat → repeat
example_prompts: kiting game where goblins chase my archer cat
vampire survivors style kiting
ranged hero versus melee mob
